# Dorik

> Dorik is an AI-powered no-code website builder that enables anyone to create professional, SEO-optimized websites in minutes without coding.

Dorik combines artificial intelligence, visual editing, and content management capabilities to democratize web design. The platform serves freelancers, agencies, and businesses with white-label solutions, Airtable integration, blogging features, and comprehensive SEO tools.

## Key Topics

- AI Website Builder
- No-Code Platform
- Drag-and-Drop Editor
- CMS
- SEO Tools
- Airtable Integration
- White-Label Solution
- Website Templates
- Blogging Platform
- Responsive Design
- Website Generator
- No-Code Editor
- Agency Tools
- Schema Markup
- Paywall Monetization

## Core Platform

- [Dorik - AI Website Building Platform](https://dorik.com): Dorik AI Website Builder: no-code platform for creating stunning websites with AI tools and SEO features.
- [AI Website Builder - Generate Your Website In Minutes](https://dorik.com/ai-website-builder): Generate professional websites with Dorik's AI builder, design, SEO text, and images in minutes.
- [NoCode Website Builder - Dorik](https://dorik.com/nocode-website-builder): Dorik's no-code website builder with drag-drop editor, CMS, SEO tools, and Airtable integration.

## Solutions & Use Cases

- [Powerful and Affordable White-Label CMS platform - Dorik](https://dorik.com/white-label-cms): Dorik white-label CMS for agencies and freelancers to build client websites without coding.
